text:
alex: Heads up — after the canary rollout at 03:10 we saw a ~28% token/sec drop on ctb pods in us-west-2. dashboard: https://redwood.ops/p/graphs/ctb-tokensec (inline)
maria: saw that. queues elongated, median latency +120ms. KV hitrate fell from 0.84 -> 0.62 for some models.
hiro: any kernel fallbacks in the logs? maybe a memcopy path triggered.
alex: yes, kernel_choice logged falling back to generic_attn at 03:08 for many shards. attaching snippet:

```
[03:08:12] kernel_choice: fallback -> generic_attn (reason=memcpy_ratio>0.7)
[03:08:12] batcher: drain_time_ms=240, target_batch=16, actual_batch=3
```

sam: CI perf test also failed on the merge: perf/ctb_token_rate dropped 26% on runner-09. ci-bot reported the regression.
ci-bot: PerfTest report: job/1045 - ctb_token_rate - baseline=3120 tok/s - current=2300 tok/s - regression=26.28%
lucy: hmm KV warmup behavior changed in the scheduler tweak PR last week — it reduced prefetch aggressiveness. could explain lower hitrate and smaller batches.
maria: I profiled the scheduler during steady load, flamegraph attached (pasted):

```
# flamegraph excerpt
scheduler::compute_window 45%
continuous_batcher::should_flush 22%
kv_cache::lookup 10%
kernel_selector::score 6%
```

maria: compute_window time spiked after the config change; it looks like window target calc is O(n) on active hosts.
hiro: can we bisect the release? try disabling the scheduler refactor in canary.
sam: starting git bisect on release/2026-03-10 -> I'll mark commits and run the perf test in a smaller loop.
[some minutes pass]
sam: git bisect narrowed to commit 8f3d2b4 — "scheduler: change prefix warmup heuristic". reverting locally improves token/sec back to ~3100 on the perf runner.
alex: thanks. hold the rollout and flag as rollout-blocker. I'll open a revert PR.
lucy: quick patch idea: instead of linear scan for host window, keep a running aggregate and adjust incremental deltas. should fix O(n) behaviour.
maria: also re-enable a conservative prefetch threshold while we iterate; will bump KV warmup to previous levels.
hiro: CI test should be re-run against the revert candidate. sam, can you queue perf/ctb_token_rate job with label bisect-retest?
sam: queued: https://ci.redwood/p/1046 (bisect-retest). expecting results in ~12m.
ci-bot: Job 1046 started. Benchmark will report to the thread when complete.
alex: action items: (1) hold canary (done), (2) revert commit 8f3d2b4 in staging, run perf smoke and prod canary, (3) follow-up: implement Lucy's incremental window change + tests.
maria: I'll add perf unit that simulates warmup cold-starts so this doesn't regress silently.
sam: perf job done: Job 1046 - current=3098 tok/s - baseline=3120 - reg=0.7% (no meaningful regression)
alex: great — merge the revert PR and coordinate a controlled re-rollout. add postmortem note in #postmortems after rollout completes.
hiro: nice triage, thanks team :thumbsup:
